query: How many Ages are there and how many cards do you play each Age?
ground_truth: A game of 7 Wonders is played over 3 Ages, and each player plays 6 cards per Age.

query: What do the green cards do?
ground_truth: Green cards are Scientific Structures; they score victory points depending on your progress in the three scientific fields.

query: What are the brown cards in 7 Wonders?
ground_truth: Brown cards are Raw Materials; these structures produce resources.

query: What do red cards represent?
ground_truth: Red cards are Military Structures; they increase your military might, which comes into play during Conflict resolution.

query: What are the purple cards?
ground_truth: Purple cards are Guilds; they allow players to score victory points according to specific criteria, and they appear in the Age III deck.

query: What three actions can I take with my chosen card on a turn?
ground_truth: With your chosen card you may build the structure, build a stage of your Wonder, or discard the card to gain 3 coins.

query: How many coins do I get for discarding a card?
ground_truth: Discarding a card lets you take 3 coins from the bank and add them to your treasury.

query: Can I build two of the same structure?
ground_truth: No. A player can never build two identical structures (those with the same name or illustration).

query: In what order must I build my Wonder stages?
ground_truth: The stages of a Wonder must be built in order, from left to right.

query: When I build a Wonder stage, which cost do I pay?
ground_truth: You pay the price shown on the Wonder board, not the cost shown on the card used as the construction marker.

query: How much does it cost to buy a resource from a neighbor?
ground_truth: For each resource bought from a neighboring city, you must give 2 coins to the owner of that resource.

query: Can I buy the resources produced by a neighbor's yellow commercial cards?
ground_truth: No. You cannot buy resources produced by some commercial structures (yellow cards) or by some Wonders; those are reserved for their owner. You can only buy a city's initial board resources and resources from its brown and gray cards.

query: Can a neighbor refuse to sell me a resource?
ground_truth: No. Players can never refuse to sell resources to a neighboring city.

query: Can I use coins I earned this turn to buy resources on the same turn?
ground_truth: No. To buy resources you must have the coins at the beginning of the turn. Coins earned through commerce during a turn cannot be used that turn, only the next one.

query: Do some cards reduce the cost of buying resources from neighbors?
ground_truth: Yes. Some commercial structures (yellow cards) reduce the cost of buying resources from a neighbor from 2 coins to 1 coin.

query: How are military conflicts resolved?
ground_truth: At the end of each Age, each player compares their military might (shields) with their two neighboring cities, receiving a Victory token for more shields and a Defeat token for fewer.

query: What are the values of the victory conflict tokens in each Age?
ground_truth: Victory tokens are worth +1 at the end of Age I, +3 at the end of Age II, and +5 at the end of Age III.

query: What is the value of a military defeat token?
ground_truth: A military Defeat token has a value of -1.

query: How do you score sets of identical scientific symbols?
ground_truth: For each of the 3 scientific symbols, identical symbols score: 1 symbol = 1 point, 2 identical = 4 points, 3 identical = 9 points, 4 identical = 16 points.

query: How many points is a set of 3 different scientific symbols worth?
ground_truth: Each group of 3 different scientific symbols scores 7 victory points, and this is cumulative with the points from sets of identical symbols.

query: How are coins converted to points at the end of the game?
ground_truth: For every 3 coins you have at the end of the game, you score 1 victory point. Leftover coins score no points.

query: Who wins if there is a tie at the end of the game?
ground_truth: In case of a tie, the player with the most coins in their treasury wins. A tie on coins is not broken further.

query: In what order are victory points counted at the end?
ground_truth: Count points in this order: military conflicts, treasury contents, Wonder, civilian structures, scientific structures, commercial structures, and guilds.

query: How many coins does each player start with?
ground_truth: Each player begins the game with 3 coins (three value '1' coins) placed on their board.

query: How many Guild cards are used in a 4-player game?
ground_truth: In a 4-player game, 6 Guild cards are used.

query: What is the second-stage effect of the Colossus of Rhodes on side A?
ground_truth: On side A, the Colossus of Rhodes adds 2 Shields to your total in each conflict resolution.

query: What does the Temple of Artemis in Ephesus give on side A?
ground_truth: On side A, the Temple of Artemis gives the player 9 coins from the bank, taken once immediately after the stage is built.

query: What can the Mausoleum of Halicarnassus do?
ground_truth: The Mausoleum of Halicarnassus lets the player look through all cards discarded since the beginning of the game, pick one, and build it for free.

query: How many stages and points does the Pyramids of Giza side B have?
ground_truth: On side B, the Pyramids of Giza are built in 4 stages, each worth victory points (3, 5, 5 and 7) for a total of 20 points.

query: What happens on the sixth turn of an Age?
ground_truth: On the sixth and final turn of an Age, players receive a two-card hand, choose one to play normally, and discard the other face down. Then the Age ends.

query: Is building my Wonder mandatory?
ground_truth: No. Construction of the Wonder is not mandatory; a player can win the game without finishing or even starting their Wonder.

query: How does the 2-player game work?
ground_truth: In the 2-player 'Expert' variant, players also manage a neutral Free city; the player holding the Free city card chooses two cards (one for their own city and one for the Free city) while the opponent chooses one normally.

query: Which direction do the card hands pass?
ground_truth: After playing a card, each player passes their remaining hand to a neighbor; the direction of the hands' rotation changes with each Age.

query: What is the recommended minimum age to play 7 Wonders?
ground_truth: The rule book does not address a recommended minimum player age.

query: How long does a typical game of 7 Wonders take to play?
ground_truth: The rule book does not address the expected playing time of a game.
